hooks.command: bash -c 'INPUT=$(cat); SKILL_ROOT=".claude/skills"; FILE_PATH=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // .tool_input.path // empty"); if [[ "$FILE_PATH" == *"$SKILL_ROOT"* ]]; then SKILL_NAME=$(echo "$FILE_PATH" | sed -n "s|.*$SKILL_ROOT/\([^/]*\)/.*|\1|p"); if [[ -n "$SKILL_NAME" && -d "$SKILL_ROOT/$SKILL_NAME/memory" ]]; then echo "{\"timestamp\": \"$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)\", \"event\": \"self_mutation\", \"tool\": \"$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r .tool_name)\", \"file\": \"$FILE_PATH\"}" >> "$SKILL_ROOT/$SKILL_NAME/memory/execution-log.jsonl"; fi; fi'
